steps.en: The paid duplicate notice is permanently suspended by OCMS
steps.id: Notice duplicate yang sudah dibayar disuspend permanen oleh OCMS
steps.why_en: Only the new notice is suspended; the paid one is not touched.
steps.why_id: Hanya notice baru yang disuspend; notice yang sudah dibayar tidak disentuh.

steps.en: OCMS checks if an SMS or email was already sent that day
steps.id: OCMS mengecek apakah SMS/email tentang pelanggaran sudah dikirim di hari yang sama
steps.why_en: No code links the suspension to earlier same-day messages.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada kode yang mengaitkan suspend dengan pesan di hari yang sama.

steps.en: A refund is started for the paid notice
steps.id: Refund dimulai untuk notice yang sudah dibayar
steps.why_en: Refunds exist only in the manual suspension route, not in the automatic duplicate route.
steps.why_id: Refund hanya ada di jalur suspend manual, tidak di jalur otomatis duplicate.

steps.en: The message says the notice is cancelled and a refund will be processed
steps.id: Pesan menyatakan notice dibatalkan dan refund akan diproses
steps.why_en: No cancellation or refund wording exists in the messages.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada kalimat pembatalan atau refund di pesan.

steps.en: The SMS or email reaches the vehicle owner
steps.why_en: A generic sender exists but is not used for this and is switched off in the prod settings.
steps.why_id: Pengirim umum ada tapi tidak dipakai untuk ini dan dimatikan di setelan prod.
